company.description: Agnost AI provides analytics and optimization infrastructure for teams building conversational and voice AI agents. The platform reads production conversations between AI agents and users, extracts intent and sentiment signals, and identifies where users get stuck or drop off. It runs continuous evaluations to detect failures that standard evals miss and highlights high-impact issues in agent behavior. Agnost AI then helps teams prioritize, review, and ship fixes so agents improve based on real-world usage. It supports any large language model or framework and focuses on measuring agent experience, trust, task completion, and recovery over time. Agnost AI is used to make AI agents more reliable, efficient, and aligned with user needs in production environments.
